name: Sakura
source:
A mysterious girl who unexpectedly shows up at Shoutarou and Akira's door. She seems to resemble someone familiar…

[Spoiler]Real name: Honey
Height: 174 cm (6'8.5) 
Age: 17
Birthday: October 3rd, 1952

Several years after her kidnapping to Japan and death, Mrs. Enya came across her corpse and revived her.

She had lost her memories, but she is definitely [url=/c85106]Akira's[/url] little sister.

It was Mrs. Enya's side effects that had been keeping her alive, but her time had run out…

She goes back to her home country with a comb to remember Mrs. Enya by, and is now living with her parents.

She is now [url=/c85105]Shoutarou's[/url] sister-in-law.[/spoiler] 

[Based on the in-game profile]
